<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Railway infrastructure boost:</strong> The Union Cabinet approved three multi-tracking railway projects spanning 656 kilometers across 14 districts in West Bengal, Jharkhand, Odisha, Madhya Pradesh, and Chhattisgarh.</li>
  <li><strong>FCRA and NGO funding:</strong> The State Bank of India is seeking regulatory clarity regarding the handling of funds belonging to NGOs whose Foreign Contribution Regulation Act registrations have been cancelled.</li>
</ul>
